# An image fetched while the program runs, from the local server the script
# harness runs at 127.0.0.1:47819 (internal/testhttp): the image
# reports @load when its picture arrives and @error when the fetch fails, on
# every target that fetches one. android ships its own loader for it.
#
# An image whose URL changes fetches the new one: `moved` switches from a
# picture to a 404, and reports the failure. android's loader kept the last
# URL's picture and reported it loaded, since a picture already there skipped
# the fetch -- the Pokédex's cards kept their artwork when the dex changed.

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '3 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

const server = "http://127.0.0.1:47819"

component pictures node {
    var loaded = false
    var failed = ""
    image(@load { loaded = true }) {
        remote(url="{server}/dot.png")
    }
    image(@error(e) { failed = e.message }) {
        remote(url="{server}/status/404")
    }
}

component moved node {
    var url = "{server}/dot.png"
    var loaded = false
    var failed = ""
    image(@load { loaded = true }, @error(e) { failed = e.message }) {
        remote(url=url)
    }
    button #away(text="Away", @click { url = "{server}/status/404" })
}

func testRemoteFollowsItsURL(t Test, c moved) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loaded, 5000)
    c.away.click()
    t.wait(func() => c.failed != "", 5000)
    t.assert(c.failed != "")
}

func testRemoteLoads(t Test, c pictures) {
    t.wait(func() => c.loaded, 5000)
    t.assert(c.loaded)
}

func testRemoteFails(t Test, c pictures) {
    t.wait(func() => c.failed != "", 5000)
    t.assert(c.failed != "")
}

window {
    pictures
}
